data.gender_notes: Phebe is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Phoibe, meaning 'bright' or 'shining'. In Greek mythology, Phoibe was the Titan goddess of prophecy and the moon. In Christianity, Phebe is mentioned in the New Testament as a deaconess in the church at Cenchreae. The name Phebe carries the meaning “Bright, Shining” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Phebe usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Phebe belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Phebe total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: פיבי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פיבי הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו זוהר, שמחה, שמש. השם פיבי מוזכר בברית החדשה, בספר הרומיים טו 1:1, כאחת הנשים ששימשה כדיאקונסית בקהילת הכנסייה הקורינתית. השם פיבי משויך לאור, שמחה וחיות.

in_greek.name: Φοίβη
in_greek.long_meaning: Φοίβη (Phoibe) σημαίνει φως, χαρά, λάμψη. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, συγκεκριμένα στη Ρωμαίους 16:1-2, αναφέρεται ως διάκονος της εκκλησίας των Κορίνθιων. Ο όρος σχετίζεται με την έννοια του φωτός και της χαράς, αντανακλώντας πνευματικές αρετές.

in_latin.name: Phoebe
in_latin.long_meaning: Phoebe, derived from Greek Φοίβη (Phoibe), signifies bright, radiant, or shining one. In the New Testament, Romans 16:1-2, Phoebe is mentioned as a deaconess of the church in Cenchrea. The name conveys light, joy, and spiritual luminosity.

in_english.name: Phebe
in_english.long_meaning: Phebe, originating from Greek Φοίβη (Phoibe), means bright, shining, or radiant. Referenced in Romans 16:1-2 of the New Testament as a deaconess in the Corinthian church, Phebe symbolizes light, joy, and spiritual brilliance. Historically, the name Phebe has been used across Christian cultures, embodying purity, hope, and devotion. The name is associated with positive personality traits such as warmth, optimism, and kindness.
